column1: # Benchmark routes: name, scene (scenes.tsv), window, class, description. Launch arguments and pad live in the scene.
# Window: marker:<m>+<s> = from that many seconds after the marker (game.tsv) to 1 s before the end; present:<scene>+<n> = from the
# n-th present after the scene opened; <a>s..<b>s = run seconds. Frame times before the window include loading and are not quoted.
# Class perf = quiet machine, AC power, no other GPU client (docs/reference/profiling.md). Runs over 90 s need NPS5_RUN_REASON.
